attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.summary: A per-participant day-of attendance record for an event
attendance.description: Records whether one character actually showed up to one event. One record per (event, character) pair. The game master ticks participants in at the door: `status` moves from `registered` to `checked-in` or `no-show`. `checkedInAt` and `checkedInBy` are stamped server-side and are never accepted from the client. Attendance grounds the post-event 'full attendance' XP award and enriches the GM run-sheet; it never grants XP by itself. Writes are restricted to game masters; reads are open to authenticated app users.

event.title: Event
event.description: UUID reference to the larping_event this attendance record belongs to

character.title: Character
character.description: UUID reference to the character whose attendance this record captures

status.title: Status
status.description: The participant's day-of attendance state for this event

checkedInAt.title: Checked In At
checkedInAt.description: When the game master recorded this attendance (server-stamped; ignored from the client body)

checkedInBy.title: Checked In By
checkedInBy.description: Nextcloud uid of the game master who recorded this attendance (server-stamped; ignored from the client body)
